verdict.rationale: Capsule documents connecting a mailbox to send email from within Capsule. It also offers Gmail and Outlook integrations that let users add conversations to records from the inbox, plus a forwarding address for storing emails. However, the evidence shows manual or one-way capture, not two-way sync with automatic matching to records. Missing for 10: documented two-way email sync, automatic logging of emails to the matching contact/opportunity records, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records

citations.quote: Connect your mailbox and send emails from within Capsule in just a few clicks.
Access Capsule directly from Gmail. Add contacts, conversations, tasks and sales opportunities.
Easily manage contacts, conversations & sales opportunities from within your Outlook inbox.
Forward emails to an email address unique to your account - an easy way to store emails.
